name: FrenchModelVariant831_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant831_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the header-792 bolt entry reworked for three bolts with flares); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant831-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-814/911 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant814us_entry.c, which selects flare CLUT row 0x3D20, at the same addresses. French header 831 is this raw image's header word, not the US header-831 source model_variant/variant831_entry.c. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
